turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - b3_supercon_train.csv: 300 real materials, columns `composition`
    (element fractions as a compact formula string) and `target` (the
    measured critical temperature Tc (K)).
  - b3_supercon_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE materials whose critical temperature
    Tc (K) was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and `composition`.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST critical
temperature Tc (K), then select the 5 best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
## Reasoning from the training data

**What the training set teaches about Tc scaling:**

| Family (train examples) | Tc range |
|---|---|
| Elements, alloys, A15, borocarbides, Fe-pnictides | 0–40 K |
| 214 cuprates (La₂₋ₓSrₓCuO₄), electron-doped RE₂₋ₓCeₓCuO₄ | 10–40 K |
| YBCO/RE-123, Bi-2212 | 60–93 K |
| Tl-2201 / Tl-2212, Hg-1201 | 70–108 K |
| **Bi-2223 (Pb-doped), Tl-2223, Cu/Tl-1234, Hg-1223** | **105–137 K** |

The top of the training distribution is dominated by **3–4 CuO₂-layer Tl/Hg/Bi/Cu "12(n-1)n" phases**: Tl1Ba2Ca2Cu3O8 = 123 K, Hg1Ba2Ca2Cu3F0.6O = 130 K, Tl0.8Hg0.2Ba2Ca2Cu3O9 = 137 K, Hg0.9Pb0.1Ba2Ca2Cu3O8.25 = 118 K, Cu0.5Tl0.5Ba2Ca1.6Mg0.4Cu3O10 = 115 K, Bi1.7Pb0.3(Sb)Sr2Ca2Cu3O = 106–111 K.

**Screening the pool for those signatures (Hg/Tl/Cu-cation + Ba/Sr₂ + Ca₂₊ + Cu₃₊):**

- **c084 Hg0.7Bi0.3Sr2Ca2Cu3O8.35** – Hg-1223 three-layer phase (the very hottest family in training, 118–137 K); Sr-for-Ba and Bi co-doping trim it somewhat → ~115–125 K.
- **c029 Ag0.25Cu0.75Ba2Ca3Cu4O11** – Cu-1234 (four CuO₂ layers); the closest training analogue Cu₀.₅Tl₀.₅Ba₂Ca₂Cu₃O₁₀ = 115 K → ~115 K.
- **c034 Tl2Ba2Ca5Cu6O16** – Tl-2256, multilayer Tl cuprate; Tl-2223 in training = 110–123 K, higher n drops slightly → ~110–115 K.
- **c046 Bi1.7Pb0.2Mo0.1Sr2Ca2Cu3O** – classic Pb-doped Bi-2223 (training analogues 106–111 K) → ~108 K.
- **c081 Bi3.2Pb0.2V0.6Sr4Ca5Cu7O** – doubled-formula Pb/V-doped Bi-2223-type multilayer → ~105–110 K.
- (Runners-up: c097 Bi-2234 Ag ~103 K, c072 Bi-2212-rich ~90 K, c036/c038/c044/c062 Tl-2212/Bi-2212 ~85–100 K, c095 Pb-3212 ~75 K.)

Everything else in the pool sits in lower-Tc families: 123-type YBCO/RE-123 (c049, c075, c071, c088, c090, c094 ≈ 90 K max), 214 and electron-doped cuprates (c022, c026, c037, c063, c065 ≈ 20–40 K), Fe-based (c001, c050, c058, c066, c098 ≈ 20–40 K), MgB₂-type (c023 ≈ 35 K), and simple alloys/binaries (c002, c006, c039, c052, c086 < 10 K).

**Final: c084, c029, c034, c046, c081**
